effectAndAuthorityAssessment: This is a compile-only operation. The argv carries `--no-run` (H043), so Cargo compiles the real unmodified `mori` binary graph and exactly the `mcp_check_stdio` and `lsp` integration harnesses and stops before executing any test function, server, or product runtime. The enumerated host effects — the 37 build-script binaries, the 33 proc-macro expansions (including halo2derive host BigUint modular arithmetic producing field constants and the SDK serialize/storage/base-crypto/ledger-static token-construction macros), native C/assembly compilation, archiving and linking of blst (H019: cc.compile("blst"), host ADX/CPUID/flag behavior) and AWS-LC (H018 get_builder → bundled CC/CMake or system path), the cc jobserver (H038/H039), AWS-LC default system discovery via pkg-config without OPENSSL_* vars (H018/H024), the conditional guarded GNU memcmp diagnostic (H021), and the onchain-runtime default vendored branch that skips Scheme generation (H020) — are all ordinary compiler/build-host effects. None of them is an SDK runtime operation. The governing execution boundary (H009/H010/H011) blocks a specific, enumerated set of SDK RUNTIME API executions: relation/circuit checks, k()/degree queries, VM/transcript execution, keygen, proving, native verification, deploy/ledger, and private-key/PK/SRS/cache actions. A `--no-run` compile reaches none of those; compiling the libraries that contain those APIs is categorically distinct from invoking them, and the operation's excludedActions enforce that distinction structurally. mori reaches SDK/native source only because mori-backend and mori-ledger are normal, nonoptional dependencies (H002); this is a larger compile surface than prior SDK-free Core/diagnostics builds, not a crossing of the runtime boundary. I apply the present whole execution-focus body (H009), which records the October-18 beta override at its head and expressly qualifies the historical native-zero/human-only records; I do not rely on the absent canonical assignment file (H044) and reinstate no removed human-only step. The product contract (H008: author/compile/prove/publish/deploy without maintainer approval) and AGENTS.md (H007: routine execution decisions without repeated permission) treat compilation as ordinary, permissionless work. No feature weakening, probe suppression, AWS-LC override, or system/bundled-linkage assumption is inserted; the FIPS/link-run probe, bindgen/SSL, and nonvendored Scheme remain visible non-selected source branches, not requested execution. On that basis the enumerated host effects are permitted for this exact bounded 90s TERM+5/MAX1 operation. This permit asserts no success, resource sufficiency, actual compiler/system-library selection, backend identity, TCB soundness, or any cryptographic/financial/SDK acceptance; a produced compile result would require separate result inspection, and protocol/test execution remains a later, separately-selected decision with F3/B1/PR310 and all native/proof/financial/ledger acceptance left open.
